fair_value.method: Blend of a pro-forma SOTP (low and constructive cases, midpoint ~$8.96, weight 0.6), a discounted 2028 run-rate EV/EBITDA at 18x plus undeveloped-asset value (~$7.76, weight 0.25) and a haircut sell-side strategic-premium cross-check ($13.5, weight 0.15). All on ~331M pro-forma basic shares (249.97M at 7/31/26 + ~14.8M ASM + 65.85M VAC) and ~$0.885B net claims at the VAC close (~$0.75B net debt + up to $135M Ara preferred).

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: Low case EV $3.3B: US uranium (White Mesa, Pinyon Plain ~2M lb/yr at ~$23/lb cost, resources) $1.0B; White Mesa REE incl. heavy-REE circuits (NdPr, Dy and Tb oxides now all qualified by magnet makers) $0.6B; VAC (2025 adj. EBITDA $29M; Sumter run-rate $65-75M at 2,000 tpa) $1.0B; ASM (Korean Metals Plant + Dubbo) $0.25B; Donald/Toliara/Bahia $0.4B; vanadium/isotopes $0.05B -> equity $2.415B / 331M = $7.30. Constructive case EV $4.4B (uranium $1.3B at ~$150M EBITDA x ~8.5x; REE $1.0B; VAC $1.3B; ASM $0.3B; Donald/Toliara $0.5B, trimmed from $0.6B because Donald FID has slipped again) -> equity $3.515B / 331M = $10.62. Midpoint $8.96. Net claims $0.885B: $700M 0.75% converts (conv. $20.34, out of the money, treated as debt) + $140M VAC adjusted net debt (refinanced by $250M Goldman loan, net-neutral) - ~$95M cash left at close ($936.7M at 6/30 less $718M VAC cash, ~$24M ASM cash, ~$100M burn/capex) + up to $135M Ara preferred (likely triggered, threshold $20.93).

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2028 run-rate pro-forma EBITDA ~$190M (uranium ~$120M at ~$85-95/lb realized; VAC ~$90M, cut from $100M because 4,000 tpa Sumter is unproven and a 2027 VAC EBITDA of $60-90M is the defensible range; REE oxides ~$30M; ASM ~$10M; less ~$60M corporate G&A) x 18x (cut from 20x so the strategic premium is not double-counted with the constructive SOTP; still above generic miners given Western critical-minerals scarcity and uranium peer multiples) = $3.42B, discounted one year at 12% = $3.05B, plus $0.4B undeveloped assets (Donald, Toliara, Bahia) not in the EBITDA, = $3.45B EV, less $0.885B net claims = $2.57B / 331M shares.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Strategic-premium cross-check: sell-side is uniformly Buy (targets ~$16-33, mean ~$24; Cantor initiated Buy and H.C. Wainwright raised its target in Sept 2026). I haircut the mean ~45% for promotional bias and because most targets predate the ~25% VAC/ASM dilution to ~331M shares (lowered from $14.0).

bear.story: US-China rare-earth thaw keeps compressing the Western REE/magnet premium; VAC closes (early 2027) with the Ara preferred triggered and a 19.9% holder as an overhang; the OSC $725M loan (still only conditional) fails or is delayed so heavy-REE/metals-plant capex is funded with ATM/equity near lows; Donald FID keeps slipping; uranium spot eases from ~$90 toward $70. Stock trades below my low-case SOTP (~$7.3).

base.story: Uranium holds ~$85-95 spot (LT ~$96.50) with ~2M lb/yr at low cost; VAC closes in 2027-H1 and Sumter ramps toward its 2,000 tpa run-rate; Tb/Dy output grows after Japanese magnet-maker qualification; OSC loan finalized sometime in the year; Donald FID eventually reached. Market keeps a modest premium over my ~$9.35 fair value but dilution and cash burn cap the rerating; stock slightly below today's price.

bull.story: Renewed China export-control escalation or US price floors/offtakes re-ignite the critical-minerals trade; OSC loan closes and removes dilution risk; Sumter expansion toward 4,000 tpa with OEM contracts; uranium term near $100. Stock recovers toward the lower analyst targets ($18-25), as it did to its $27.90 peak within the past year.

thesis_break_reason: About $6.3 is ~$2.09B of equity on 331M shares, or ~$2.97B EV with $0.885B net claims: roughly my low-case value of uranium plus a discounted VAC, with nothing for the REE upstream, ASM or Donald. That is ~14% below my low-case SOTP ($7.30) and ~45% below spot. A move there would most likely mean something fundamental broke rather than ordinary 89%-vol noise: the VAC close failed or was renegotiated, the OSC loan fell through and forced a large discounted equity raise, or uranium fell below ~$65/lb.

key_uncertainties: Whether the market keeps paying a strategic premium for Western REE/magnet supply as US-China relations shift
VAC integration and Sumter ramp against ~$2.04B EV for $29M 2025 EBITDA; VAC revenue is not company-disclosed
Whether the conditional $725M OSC loan is finalized, or heavy-REE, metals-plant and Donald capex requires more ATM/equity
Uranium price path and durability of Pinyon Plain high-grade low-cost production
Timing of Donald FID, which has slipped twice
reasoning: UUUU (Energy Fuels) closed at $11.35, near its 52-week low after falling ~60% from $27.90, even though the uranium business is strong (spot ~$90/lb and LT ~$96.50 in the week of 9/22/26; Q2-26 production at ~$23/lb cost). The derating comes from the $1.9B VAC deal ($718M cash + 65.85M shares) and rare-earth selloffs on US-China thaw headlines. Round 2 changes, from the supervisor's evidenced findings: (1) the pro-forma share count is ~331M, not 328M (249.97M at 7/31 + ~14.8M ASM + 65.85M VAC = 19.9%); (2) cash left at close is ~$95M, not $150M, after burn, capex and ASM cash, so net claims are ~$0.885B incl. the likely-triggered Ara preferred; (3) Donald FID slipped again, so I trimmed Donald in the constructive SOTP; (4) VAC 2027 EBITDA of $60-90M, with $100M+ only in 2028 at the earliest, so I cut 2028 VAC EBITDA to $90M; (5) I accept the supervisor's point that 20x on 2028 EBITDA double-counted the strategic premium already in the constructive SOTP, cut it to 18x, and added back undeveloped assets that EBITDA misses. My follow-up searches confirmed that the OSC loan is still conditional and that VAC is expected to close in early 2027. They also turned up the Aug-19 qualification of EF's terbium oxide by Japan's largest magnet maker (NdPr, Dy and Tb now all qualified), which supports but does not raise my REE value, and Sept analyst actions (Cantor Buy, HCW target raise). The SOTP falls to $7.30-10.62 (mid $8.96) and EV/EBITDA to $7.76, and the blended fair value is $9.35 (from $9.75), ~18% below spot. I disagree slightly with the supervisor that the corrections should leave the ladder unchanged: my own fair value fell ~4% and the funding/dilution risk from a conditional OSC loan is more concrete, so I moved the median from ~$11.0 to ~$10.7 and put slightly more weight in the left tail (bear prob 0.27). Offsets are strong uranium, mean reversion after a 60% drawdown, bullish sell-side positioning and policy-shock upside that has doubled this name before. Width is a lognormal sigma ~0.72, below the 89% realized vol but still wide for a high-beta theme name: P(>= $11.35) = 0.465, P(>= $19.86) ~0.195, P(>= $28) ~0.09, P(< $6.81) ~0.27. Research: 13 searches plus fetches in round 1 and 5 more searches in round 2. No option data was used.
